description: A quote binds, serves and acts on only a contact of its own tenant (R0-04 review finding ST-R004-1; R0-CMF3 review findings ST-CMF3-1/2/3 and CR-CMF3-1). Run from apps/server: npx vitest run test/quote-contact-tenant.integration.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.proof/k04b-vitest.json against a migrated isolated database and REDIS_URL, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/quote-contact-tenant.json --report .proof/k04b-vitest.json. WRITES: createQuote and updateQuote resolve contactId inside the path tenant (assertContactInBusiness, R0-27 review ST-27-2 at 76e1c59d): a foreign, unknown or soft-deleted contact answers the same 404 'Contact not found' and no Quote row is written or changed; convertQuoteToInvoice refuses a foreign contact the same way. LEGACY ROWS (a quote written before those checks that still points at another tenant's contact): every reader in apps/server/src/modules/commerce/commerce.service.ts that joins a quote's contact serves that contact as null, namely getQuote and getQuoteForBusiness (detail route, sendQuoteEmail's reads, KEY getQuoteStatus), updateQuote, updateQuoteStatus (the status route, send-email's DRAFT-to-SENT step, public accept and reject), getQuoteByToken and markQuoteViewedByToken (the public token view), listQuotes, getStaleQuotes and markQuoteFollowedUp; and the events those paths emit (quote.updated, quote.expiry_changed, quote.sent, quote.accepted, quote.rejected, quote.viewed, quote.stale), the CRM timeline writes and the public visitor stitch carry neither that contact nor its id. The public accept/reject answer carries only { firstName, lastName, email } (it answered the whole Contact row to an anonymous caller, for same-tenant rows too). RED-BEFORE: at 8f19d686 the three legacy-row detail/patch cases fail; at 483d7862 eight of the nine R0-CMF3 cases fail (the status-route positive control passes there); the create and patch refusal cases fail when assertContactInBusiness is removed (mutation probe, 4 cases). RESIDUALS, not covered by this proof: (1) listQuotes, getStaleQuotes and markQuoteFollowedUp still serve a same-tenant contact's WHOLE row (phone, internal notes, owner, visibility) to any revenue:read member; that is the R28-ST-01 projection class, not tenancy. (2) Readers outside commerce.service.ts that join a quote's contact with no tenant condition are not audited here: flow/flow.service.ts:137, ai/strategic-intelligence.service.ts:447, crm/crm-actions.service.ts:127/137/185, commerce/commerce-ai.service.ts:82/360/507/711/1079, commerce/revenue-briefing.service.ts:91, commerce/revenue-action.service.ts:278/314/357. (3) A legacy row's stored contactId (an opaque id) is still served on operator reads and is not re-pointed; the operator repairs it with a PATCH naming a contact of the tenant. (4) Whether legacy rows exist at all is unmeasured: the census SELECT count(*) FROM quotes q JOIN contacts c ON c.id = q.contact_id WHERE c.business_id <> q.business_id was not run against any shared or production database (no authority). The flipped joined-row case in commerce-quote-visibility.integration.test.ts is bound by quote-detail-route.json.
requiredCases: fixture sanity (real rows) seeded two tenants, B's live and soft-deleted contacts, A's canary contact, B's own quote and two legacy B quotes joined to A's contact
